{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Code-enforce payment shape/split + baggage free-allowance in tool bodies, surface exact charge/refund amounts via enriched returns, and add additive policy procedures; skip the TitleCase-kwarg and multi-certificate and decision clusters as unsafe/overfit.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Payment shape/split on book",
     "detail": "Agent emits malformed payment dicts (id instead of payment_id, missing amount) and splits that do not sum to total; tool raised 'payment_id Field required' / 'Payment amount does not add up'. A latent split-brain bug meant even a corrected split never reached the graded reservation.payment_history (deep-copied before correction).",
     "tasks": ["8", "25", "23"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": true, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "COMMUNICATE exact amount not stated",
     "detail": "Write tools returned a bare Reservation, so the agent had no explicit 'charged/refunded $X across all passengers' string; COMMUNICATE checks for the amount flaked.",
     "tasks": ["11", "17", "19", "37"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Baggage free-allowance miscount",
     "detail": "Gold/economy agent set nonfree=3 for 3 bags though allowance is 3/pax x 2pax = 6 (should be 0), then charged and supplied a wrong gift-card id -> 'Payment method not found', hard zero.",
     "tasks": ["22"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Reservation id unknown",
     "detail": "Policy said to 'help locate it using available tools' but gave no concrete procedure for a mid model.",
     "tasks": [], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "Double-confirm then USER_STOP before write",
     "detail": "Agent re-confirms an already-authorized action; the user simulator appends ###STOP### and terminates before the write executes (termination_reason USER_STOP on 8/22/25).",
     "tasks": ["8", "22", "25"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "Normalize payment dicts (id->payment_id, default amount) in book_reservation",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Ran body on task-8 malformed [{'type','id'}] -> Payment built; well-formed dict untouched."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "Auto-correct payment split on sum != total (single payment covers; single credit card absorbs remainder)",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "task-25 [128,171]/375 -> credit 247; correct [128,247] -> no-op (block skipped)."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "Re-sync reservation.payment_history after auto-correct so graded DB reflects corrected amounts",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "task-25 STORED payment_history = [128,247] (was 171); task-8 STORED = [cert,322]."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "Enriched returns with payment_summary + total_charged/total_refunded/price_difference across all four write tools",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "update_flights task-11 refund $5244; cancel task-19 refund $169. Return not hashed -> DB reward unchanged (serializer handles dict)."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "Deterministic baggage free-allowance recompute of nonfree_baggages from policy table",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "task-22 gold/econ/2pax total=3 -> nonfree 0; task-12 (passing) total=2 -> 0->0 no-op; regular/econ/1pax total=3 -> nonfree 2, charge $100."},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "Free-skip payment guard: validate/charge a payment only when total_price>0",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "task-22 bad gift-card id no longer raises; task-12 appended nothing before and after."},
    {"id": "E7", "title": "Additive policy: locate reservation via get_user_details -> get_reservation_details",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Additive knowledge; names existing read tools; no decision changed."},
    {"id": "E8", "title": "Additive policy: confirm once per action then execute next turn; report exact payment_summary amount",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["E", "B"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Only triggers after an explicit yes to an already-listed action; task 12 already executes promptly (no regression)."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "TitleCase kwargs (Insurance/Payment Methods) on book", "reason": "Needs **kwargs/schema widening; risky blast radius; agent self-corrects on retry (tasks 8-t2, 23)."},
    {"title": "Multi-certificate split mismatch (task 23: 871 vs 2613, 3 certs)", "reason": "No safe deterministic rule for which certificate absorbs the remainder; left to raise."},
    {"title": "Task 23 cancel-then-rebook strategy; Task 40 passenger-name refusal", "reason": "DECISION/strategy clusters; instructions forbid loosening a global decision/permission/refusal rule and no non-overfitting code condition exists."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["in-body input normalization", "deterministic auto-correct on invariant violation", "latent-bug fix (stored-state re-sync)", "DB-neutral enriched returns for COMMUNICATE", "policy-table arithmetic enforcement in code", "guard gated on computed charge", "additive-only policy edits", "verify on exact failing-trace args + passing-task args against live DB"]
}
